After submitting the login form, the browser landed on the Discuss app (channel 'general'), confirming identity 'YourCompany / User' is signed in. The landing page shows the Discuss sidebar with Inbox/Starred/History, the 'general' channel, and an empty inbox ("Congratulations, your inbox is empty").

Opened the saved quotation S00023 and edited it: via the Catalogue dialog I added a SECOND product, [E-COM07] Large Cabinet (unit price 320.00), then set its Quantity to 2 on the order line. The existing first line [FURN_7777] Office Chair with quantity 3.00 / unit price 70.00 was left unchanged. I clicked Save (via the "Save manually" control, since the plain Save target times out), which returned the form to read-only state; the statusbar reads "Quotation", i.e. the order is not confirmed. I verified persistence by reloading the record from the server: it loads as S00023 with customer 'fwod70-n3 Bench Customer' (Benchville) and exactly two lines — Storage Box 3.00 × 70.00 = £47.40 and Large Cabinet 2.00 × 320.00 = £640.00 — computing Untaxed Amount £687.40 (TAX 20% £137.48, Total £824.88).

Opened saved quotation S00023 and edited the FIRST order line, changing [FURN_7777] Office Chair quantity from 3 to 5 (unit price 70.00 unchanged; the app recomputed the line to £79.00). The second line [E-COM07] Large Cabinet stayed at quantity 2.00 × 320.00 = £640.00. I saved via the "Save manually" control (the plain Save target times out), after which the form was read-only and the statusbar still showed "Quotation" checked — the order is NOT confirmed. I verified persistence by reloading the record from the server: S00023 loads with customer 'fwod70-n3 Bench Customer' (Benchville), first line Storage Box 5.00, second line Large Cabinet 2.00, and Untaxed Amount £719.00 (TAX 20% £143.80, Total £862.80).
